name: Cable Wrist Curl
cues: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley, kneel facing it and sit back towards your heels
Rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up
Let the cable pull your wrists back into a stretch
Curl your wrists up without lifting your forearms

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Only the wrists move (forearms fixed, hips at 0.34 m, knee 156 under the 158 exception). The stretch reaches only -19.4 deg (the author reported -26; bench wrist curls use -55). At the stretch the bar is 4 cm off the floor and the hands are 1.5 mm off it, so the hero reads as the hands resting on the floor. The forearms sit 21 to 24 mm above the thighs and touch the shins (-5 mm).
